result.summary: The page is mostly well laid out, but the bottom navigation has a clear defect: the Orders tab is missing its icon while the other tabs render theirs.

issues.description: In the bottom navigation bar, the Orders tab shows only its text label with no icon above it, while Home, Search, and Profile all display icons. The icon slot above 'Orders' is blank.
issues.suggestion: Render an Orders icon (e.g., a receipt or bag outline) above the Orders label in the same gray style and size as the other inactive tab icons so all four tabs are visually consistent.
